Confira a vaga para Sr Staff Engineer, Backend - Core Services em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Role As a Sr. Staff Software Engineer in Core Services, you are a technical anchor for the foundational systems that power every Uber trip, delivery, and transaction globally. Your scope extends beyond a single team; you will define the 2-3 year technical vision for Uber’s backend ecosystem. You will be responsible for the health, scalability, and evolution of our most critical infrastructure—Identity, Payments, and Safety—ensuring they remain resilient as we scale to the next 100 million users. You will act as a peer to Directors and VPs, providing the technical grounding for Uber's most ambitious business goals. What You'll Do Define the North Star: Lead the creation of a multi-year technical roadmap for Core Services, ensuring our architecture handles 10x growth while reducing systemic complexity. Architectural Governance: Serve as a key member of the Architecture Review Board, setting standards for how backend services are built, deployed, and interconnected company-wide. Buy vs. Build: Lead high-stakes evaluations for foundational technologies (databases, orchestration, messaging) that have long-term financial and operational impact.  Systems Transformation & Excellence Solve the "Impossible": Directly tackle the most ambiguous, high-risk technical challenges that represent significant single points of failure for the company. Institutionalize Reliability: Drive a company-wide shift toward "Zero-Trust" and "Always-On" architectures, re-engineering the platform to make entire classes of failures impossible. Efficiency at Scale: Lead initiatives to optimize infrastructure spend and resource utilization across tens of thousands of nodes without compromising performance.  Cross-Functional & Industry Influence Strategic Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership (VP/CTO level), translating complex technical trade-offs into business risks and opportunities. Ecosystem Leadership: Represent Uber in the broader tech community (open source, conferences, standards bodies), positioning Uber's engineering as an industry gold standard. Culture Carrier: Champion quality and long-term thinking, modeling Uber’s core values of "Go Get It" and "Build with Heart."  Mentorship of Leaders Leader of Leaders: Focus mentorship on Staff Engineers and Engineering Managers, helping them grow into organizational leaders and strategic thinkers. Sponsor Excellence: Identify and sponsor high-potential talent, ensuring a diverse and robust pipeline of future technical leaders.  Minimum Qualifications 15+ years of professional experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of delivering massive-scale distributed systems. History of Org-Wide Impact: Demonstrated ability to lead technical transformations that affect hundreds of engineers and multiple business units. Deep Mastery of Distributed Theory: Expert-level understanding of CAP theorem trade-offs, consensus algorithms (Paxos/Raft), and global data consistency models. Exceptional Communication: Ability to explain deep technical concepts to non-technical executives and build consensus across conflicting organizational priorities.  Preferred Qualifications Open Source Contribution: Significant contributions to major open-source projects in the infrastructure or distributed systems space. Vertical Expertise: Deep experience in FinTech (Payments) or Identity/Security at a global "Big Tech" scale. Future-Proofing: Experience migrating monolithic architectures to highly modular, cell-based, or serverless paradigms at scale.  Uber's mission is to reimagine the way the world moves for the better. Here, bold ideas create real-world impact, challenges drive growth, and speed fuelds progress. What moves us, moves the world - let’s move it forward, together. Offices continue to be central to collaboration and Uber’s cultural identity. Unless formally approved to work fully remotely, Uber expects employees to spend at least half of their work time in their assigned office. For certain roles, such as those based at green-light hubs, employees are expected to be in-office for 100% of their time. Please speak with your recruiter to better understand in-office expectations for this role. *Accommodations may be available based on religious and/or medical conditions, or as required by applicable law. To request an accommodation, please reach out to     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista de Customer Success Sr.
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista de Customer Success Sr. em região geográfica intermediária de são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

No Infojobs, temos um propósito claro: inspirar o crescimento profissional de pessoas e empresas por meio de soluções que impactam diretamente o mercado de trabalho. Acreditamos em um futuro com mais oportunidades, diversidade, qualidade de vida e equidade para todas as pessoas. Valorizamos a pluralidade de trajetórias, olhares e vivências. Ter um time diverso nos permite criar soluções mais criativas, humanas e conectadas com a realidade do mundo. E promover a inclusão não é apenas um compromisso ético para nós, é também um caminho para a inovação e transformação social. Então, se você valoriza um ambiente colaborativo, inovador e acolhedor - onde as diferenças são respeitadas e celebradas - essa vaga pode ser pra você! Como Analista Customer Success Sênior as suas principais atividades serão: Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes estratégicos (High Touch), garantindo alto nível de satisfação, engajamento e retenção. Atuar de forma proativa e consultiva, entendendo profundamente o negócio do cliente e conectando suas necessidades às soluções da empresa. Conduzir reuniões estratégicas e planos de sucesso personalizados. Liderar processos de renovação contratual, mitigação de churn e expansão (upsell/cross-sell), em parceria com Comercial. Antecipar riscos na jornada do cliente, propondo planos de ação claros e mensuráveis. Ser ponto focal para casos críticos e clientes em situação sensível, garantindo alinhamento interno e comunicação clara com o cliente. Acompanhar KPIs como churn, NPS, engajamento, adoção, renovação e expansão. Conduzir onboarding e jornada estratégica para clientes complexos ou de maior porte. Apoiar o time comercial em negociações estratégicas e alinhamentos com decisores. Participar ativamente de projetos transversais e iniciativas de melhoria contínua. Apoiar a construção e evolução da estratégia de Customer Success, trazendo insights do cliente para Produto, CX, Marketing e Operações. Garantir registros completos e atualizados em CRM/CJ, contribuindo para análises e tomadas de decisão. Atuar como referência técnica e comportamental para CS Pleno e Júnior, apoiando no desenvolvimento do time. Experiência sólida em Customer Success, Atendimento B2B ou Relacionamento com Clientes, preferencialmente em SaaS ou tecnologia. Vivência no atendimento a clientes enterprise ou estratégicos (High Touch). Experiência com renovações, retenção, negociação e gestão de stakeholders. Atuação prévia em ambientes de metas, indicadores e OKRs. Experiência trabalhando de forma integrada com times de Produto, Comercial, CX e Operações. Domínio de ferramentas de CRM (Salesforce) e ferramentas de gestão de CS. Capacidade de leitura e análise de dados, dashboards e indicadores de performance. Conhecimento em jornada do cliente, health score, onboarding, churn e expansão. title: Banco de Talentos | Áreas administrativas
description:
Confira a vaga para Banco de Talentos | Áreas administrativas em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Overview  Não encontrou a vaga que está buscando? Aqui você pode se candidatar para o banco das nossas áreas administrativas .   Comercial   Relações Humanas (RH) - Aqui na teya chamamos de Tê   Financeiro   Tecnologia (TI)   Jurídico     Se você está aqui é porque tem interesse em trabalhar conosco e ficamos muito felizes com isso!  Somos uma organização que gera soluções inovadoras de aprendizagem para pessoas e empresas - queremos promover transformação e atuamos como um ecossistema. Queremos nos conectar com gente boa e boa gente  de diferentes contextos, preferências, formações e com muita história pra contar, enriquecendo muito mais o nosso ecossistema.  Em nosso formato de atuação a nossa proposta é que você trabalhe por projeto (PJ) , com carga horária flexível e tempo determinado. É claro que se fizer sentido para ambos os lados, vamos te incluindo em mais projetos ao longo do tempo.  O que isso quer dizer? Que se você está buscando um trabalho flexível, autônomo e com espaço para criar muita coisa legal, aprender e crescer, se joga na rede .  Como funciona esse nosso banco?   Ao se candidatar você entrará para o nosso banco de talentos. Isso significa que você passará por um processo de seleção mas, pode ser que, em caso de aprovação, a conexão não seja imediata e sim quando novos vagas aparecerem.  Quando as vagas aparecem?   Depende da sazonalidade de vendas de projetos, necessidade de aumento da equipe e/ou necessidade de substituições e, assim que chegam, vamos atrás das pessoas certas para compor as equipes. Por isso, é muito importante termos um banco diverso e atualizado.  Main responsibilities  Qual perfil estamos buscando?    Gente boa e boa gente que gosta de aprender e não se prende em caixinhas.  Pessoas adeptas ao modelo de trabalho por projetos, autônomo e flexível.  Pessoas de diversas regiões do Brasil e do mundo.  Pessoas apaixonadas por aprendizagem e pela oportunidade de realizar projetos transformadores de pessoas e organizações, que já tenham tido experiência neste mercado ou que querem aprender sobre o mundo da aprendizagem corporativa.  Toda experiência e formação que você ache válida. Não é só sobre certificados, queremos conectar pessoas e conhecer histórias    Additional information  Acreditamos que diversidade é essencial para que possamos tornar o nosso ecossistema cada vez mais rico em suas diferenças. Queremos dar oportunidades de carreiras para todas as pessoas que desejem trabalhar conosco. Por isso, esse processo seletivo também é para todas as pessoas que se identificam como parte da comunidade negra, parda e indígena, LGBTQIA+, PCDs e todas as intersecções.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Executive Assistant
description:

Join to apply for the Executive Assistant  role at DRiV Incorporated   Executive Assistant – Job Description  Location: Brazil - Cotia  Department: Sales  Reports to: General Manager  Key Responsibilities   Provide high-level support to the executive by preparing reports, analyzing data, and delivering insights that contribute to strategic decision-making and business objectives.  Manage and coordinate key projects from planning to execution, ensuring milestones are met, and stakeholders remain informed of progress and risks.  Proactively manage complex calendars, including meetings, events, and travel arrangements, to optimize the executive’s time and ensure seamless daily operations.  Serve as the primary point of contact between the executive and internal/external stakeholders, ensuring precise, timely, and professional communication.  Prepare meeting agendas, reports, and presentations; attend meetings as needed, take accurate minutes, and follow up on all action items to ensure completion.  Manage sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion, professionalism, and integrity.  Oversee executive expenses, budgeting, and related financial reports, working closely with finance teams to ensure accuracy and compliance.  Plan and execute high-profile internal and external events, such as board meetings, leadership conferences, and corporate engagements.  Anticipate the executive’s needs, proactively identify potential issues, and provide solutions that drive efficiency, organization, and continuous improvement.    Qualifications & Requirements   Significant experience as a senior Executive Assistant or in a similar strategic support role, ideally supporting C-suite leaders or senior management.  Strong understanding of business operations and strategic priorities, with the ability to participate in high-level discussions and support informed decision-making.  Demonstrated experience managing end-to-end projects, ensuring delivery within established scope, timelines, and quality standards.  Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and operate under pressure in a dynamic environment. Solid experience in microservices and orchestration like docker, Kubernetes.  Knowledge of backup solutions is considered an added benefit, providing a competitive edge in managing comprehensive data protection strategies.  Knowledge in CSI driver, SNMP, and Active Directory/LDAP configurations.  Experience with configuration management systems (Ansible, Chef, Puppet).  Scripting experience (Python, Bash, etc) two  Excellent communication skills including prior client-facing experience and excellent team player. description:
Nova oportunidade para [ 18/09/2025 ] Almoradí se suma al Día Mundial de la Limpieza Almoradí em santos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

El sábado 20 de septiembre  la Plaza de la Constitución  acogerá, de 10 a 13:30 horas, la XIII Jornada Medioambiental de Almoradí  El Ayuntamiento de Almoradí, a través de la Concejalía de Medio Ambiente que dirige Domingo Andreu  y con el respaldo de la alcaldesa María Gómez , organiza este fin de semana dos citas destacadas en torno a la sostenibilidad y el cuidado del entorno. El sábado 20 de septiembre  la Plaza de la Constitución  acogerá, de 10 a 13:30 horas, la XIII Jornada Medioambiental de Almoradí , un evento ya consolidado en el calendario local. La programación incluye talleres para todas las edades, como “Descubre el mundo de los bichos”, “Plantas aromáticas”, “Huertos urbanos” o “Recicla por el clima”. También habrá exposición de fósiles y minerales, intercambio de ropa sostenible y actividades de concienciación sobre reciclaje y uso responsable de recursos. La jornada contará además con la participación de la Concejalía de Protección Animal, cuyo responsable Víctor Argilés  ha anunciado la presencia de Esprineco , empresa contratada por el Ayuntamiento y centro en el que se encuentran los animales recogidos en la vía pública. Durante la feria se mostrarán algunos de ellos con el objetivo de darles visibilidad y facilitar su adopción. Por su parte, desde la Concejalía de Participación Ciudadana, también dirigida por Víctor Argilés , se instalará un stand donde se realizarán encuestas y se recogerán sugerencias y propuestas vecinales, fomentando así la implicación ciudadana en la mejora del municipio. El domingo 21 de septiembre , Almoradí se sumará al World Clean Up Day , Día Mundial de la Limpieza, en una acción simultánea que se llevará a cabo en varios municipios de la Vega Baja. La actividad está promovida por las asociaciones Vega Baja Limpia  y Mocho Costero , y en el caso de Almoradí tendrá como punto de encuentro el Auditorio Municipal (Calle Torrevieja, 3)  a las 10:00 horas . Desde allí los participantes recorrerán la Ruta del Agua  en una batida de limpieza ciudadana. El Ayuntamiento de Almoradí invita a toda la ciudadanía a participar en estas actividades que buscan sensibilizar sobre la importancia de la sostenibilidad, la protección animal, la reducción de residuos y la conservación del entorno natural. La construcción de este proyecto por parte de TM Grupo Inmobiliario supone una inversión de 140 millones de euros y la generación de miles de empleos directos e indirectos en la ciudad Compártelo: Haz clic (...)   #J-18808-Ljbffr

We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in‑house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world‑class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.  KHAN ACADEMY BRAZIL  Khan Academy Brazil delivers a world‑class experience, locally relevant with content, programs, and resources for students, teachers, schools, and districts. Our platform is a supplemental digital learning resource that provides interactive, mastery‑based activities for K–12 students in Math, Portuguese, and Science—all aligned with the BNCC. We serve over 11 million learners across our website, apps, and YouTube channels, and our goal is to scale impact through deeper partnerships with public districts and school systems.  ABOUT THE ROLE  Khan Academy Brazil is seeking a Business Development Manager focused on Government Growth to join a small, mission‑driven, highly collaborative team with a big goal: expanding Khan Academy’s reach in Brazilian public education through strategic partnerships and public procurement. This role blends public‑sector business development, partnership strategy, bidding processes, and project management. You will build and manage a pipeline of opportunities with public districts, lead end‑to‑end bid processes, and use our prior partnership experience with school systems as proof points to drive expansion to other districts. If you are comfortable moving between strategic conversations with public education leaders and deep dives into RFPs, bid documents, and implementation details, this role is for you.  Your key responsibilities  Strategic growth   Design and scale partnership models with public districts, aligning Khan Academy’s pedagogical, technological, and financial value proposition with district's priorities  Use our prior partnership experience with public school systems as reference cases, structuring learnings, evidence, and narratives that can be replicated with other districts  Support local leadership in growth strategy for public districts, including sales and marketing efforts, coordinating proposals, presentations, and relationship strategies  Support philanthropic and corporate partnership efforts when relevant, including contributing to proposals, reports, or relationship management    Public‑sector pipeline and bids   Build and manage a structured pipeline of public sector opportunities, mapping priority cities and states, upcoming tenders and public calls, and partnership opportunities  Act proactively in demand generation and pre‑tender influence, where appropriate and compliant, contributing with technical input and reference models  Lead or coordinate the full cycle of public bid responses, including:  Analyzing RFPs, bid documents, terms of reference, and draft contracts  Assessing risks and legal/compliance alignment in close collaboration with legal, finance, and other functional areas  Defining commercial models, scopes, timelines, and success criteria  Preparing and consolidating technical, pedagogical, financial, and institutional documentation  Track timelines, deliverables, clarifications, and potential appeals or challenges throughout the bidding process, in close collaboration with internal and external partners    Implementation and impact   Manage end-to‑end priority partnerships with public school systems, ensuring strong implementation that drives reach, engagement, and measurable learning outcomes for students and educators  Work closely with Khan's partnership functions to design implementation, training, and support plans tailored to each district and use quantitative and qualitative data to track key metrics and propose course corrections  Translate implementation learnings into playbooks for future partnerships with public systems, collaborating with local and international teams to iterate and scale best practices    Stakeholder and relationship building   Build and maintain trust‑based relationships with decision makers in public districts (pedagogical, technical, procurement teams, among others), navigating complex political and institutional environments with empathy, strategic insight, and integrity, in order to drive change management and system‑level adoption of Khan Academy  When relevant, support philanthropic and corporate partnership efforts (funders, foundations, corporate CSR) especially when connected to programs with public districts  Act as a champion for public‑sector partners, educators, and students inside Khan Academy, bringing structured feedback to content, product, support, and strategy teams    ABOUT YOU  What you bring   10+ years of relevant experience in education, business development, consulting, sales to government, public‑sector programs, or large‑scale partnerships, with proven experience selling to or managing contracts with the public sector, ideally in education or govtech, including exposure to public procurement processes and interaction with oversight bodies  At least 3 years managing institutional partner relationships (e.g., customer success, account management, public‑sector program management) and leading complex projects or multi‑stakeholder implementations with clear, measurable outcomes  Strong business development and account management acumen, including the ability to identify new opportunities, build trust with institutional partners, and support proposal and sales cycles in the public sector  Excellent project and program management skills, with a track record of executing high‑impact initiatives across multiple districts or partners simultaneously  Advanced collaboration and influence skills, able to align internal and external stakeholders, manage cross‑functional dependencies, and drive progress without formal authority  Strong strategic and adaptive problem‑solving, able to navigate ambiguity, co‑create solutions with district leaders, and iterate based on evolving needs and political contexts  Excellent communication skills across formats and audiences, including emails, briefs, presentations, and verbal interactions with senior education leaders and technical teams  Comfort and fluency working with qualitative and quantitative data, including analyzing trends, interpreting dashboards, and extracting insights to inform decisions  Outstanding organization and time‑management abilities, capable of coordinating multiple workstreams with high attention to detail  Professionalism, discretion, and integrity, especially when managing sensitive partnerships or navigating politically complex environments  Residency in, or willingness to relocate to, São Paulo, with legal authorization to work in Brazil  Fluency in Portuguese and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages    You would be a great fit if you have   Experience working with public education systems, NGOs, or government organizations, with a strong understanding of the realities and needs of teachers, school leaders, and district administrators  Demonstrated passion for education equity and innovation, with a commitment to supporting public schools and underserved communities  Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools, such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and project management platforms (e.g., Jira, Trello, Asana, or similar)  Familiarity with AI‑powered tools for content creation, data analysis, or workflow efficiency, with curiosity about leveraging technology to improve educational outcomes  Coaching and facilitation skills, with the ability to support capacity‑building in school systems through empathetic guidance, strategic questioning, and constructive feedback  Experience with or exposure to philanthropic partnerships or CSR initiatives, especially those connected to public education    What is nice to have   Classroom teaching experience, preferably in K–12 settings, which provides valuable perspective when engaging with educators and supporting implementation  First‑hand experience using Khan Academy with students, with insight into how the platform supports instruction differentiation and learning personalization    PERKS AND BENEFITS  We may be a nonprofit, but we take great care of our team. You can expect:   Competitive compensation with healthcare and life insurance benefits  Flexible schedules and generous time off, including personal days beyond standard vacation  A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning  An exceptional team that trusts you, supports you, and gives you autonomy to do your best work  The opportunity to apply your talents to a meaningful mission, contributing to high‑impact offerings that are shaping the future of education  A kind, inclusive, and welcoming workplace, with affinity groups, ally networks, and social activities to help you connect and belong    Live & breathe learners  We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.  Take a stand  As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.  Embrace diverse perspectives  We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team. As a non‑profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.  Bring out the joy  We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co‑create with our teammates, partners and donors.  Cultivate learning mindset  We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.  Deliver wow  We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end‑to‑end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners. Na Bunge, nosso objetivo é conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes para nutrição animal e combustível essenciais para o mundo. Como uma fornecedora líder de soluções para o agronegócio, nossa equipe de aproximadamente 37.000 colaboradores dedicados atua em parceria com agricultores ao redor do mundo para movimentar commodities agrícolas de onde são produzidas para onde são necessárias — de maneira mais rápida, inteligente e eficiente. Somos uma empresa líder mundial em originação, armazenamento, distribuição, além de processamento e refino de oleaginosas, oferecendo um amplo portfólio de óleos, gorduras e proteínas de origem vegetal. A Bunge tem sede registrada em Genebra, Suíça, e sua sede corporativa está localizada em St. Louis, Missouri, EUA. Saiba mais em bunge.com.br. Estamos empenhados em promover práticas para nutrir uma cultura de pertencimento para todos. Globalmente, apoiamos os Princípios de Empoderamento das Mulheres, de ONU Mulheres. No Brasil, somos associados ao Mover - Movimento pela Equidade Racial, e fomos eleitos pela ferramenta global Disability Index Report® como um dos melhores locais para se trabalhar em relação à inclusão de pessoas com deficiência. Atuamos continuamente em prol de nosso compromisso de deixar um legado positivo em todas as comunidades onde atuamos.  Se você se identifica com esses valores, junte-se a nós! QUEM SOMOS: A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente. Esperamos que você tenha: Formação em Enfermagem e pós graduação em Nefrologia concluída. Registro no Órgão competente ativo (COREN); Experiência na área de Nefrologia e CTI; Disponibilidade de horário; Desejável conhecimento no pacote Office e em informática; Habilidade no relacionamento interpessoal e no trato com pessoas;  Informações complementares: Local de trabalho: São Paulo - SP Unidades em vários locais. title: Narrative Designer | Talent Pool
description:
Empresa está contratando Narrative Designer | Talent Pool em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

We are ARVORE, a startup in the virtual reality content creation scene. Based in São Paulo, our studio creates, designs, produces, and develops world-class interactive experiences and games for all current and future high-end immersive platforms, including virtual reality, augmented reality, and mixed reality. ARVORE is looking to hire a technically adept, creative individual to complement our team. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavors. Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility, and multidisciplinarity. We are seeking a passionate and self-motivated person with a positive attitude and a genuine team spirit, who enjoys sharing knowledge and is open to learning from others. We embrace problem solvers, those unafraid to experiment and fail, and who are ready to create something new. JOB DESCRIPTION ARVORE seeks a creative NARRATIVE DESIGNER  to design the narrative elements of our experiences and to champion story within the development process. When designing a narrative, we all know the golden rule: “show, don’t tell”. In interactive content, we may also add “do, don’t show”. The Narrative Designer must think in actions and interactions, inviting the audience to take actions and immerse their bodies within a story. It is crucial to consider the medium and the user’s body when designing a VR experience. The ND's role is to ensure that interactions and narrative work seamlessly, considering the specificities of each project. MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES: Conceive, create, and advocate for appropriate narrative features within the team, writing narrative content and ensuring it is embraced by the final product; Develop documents and tools that materialize the project's narrative content, such as emotion curves, beat sheets, synopses, mind maps, screenplays, and similar tools; Create descriptions and backstories for characters, locations, objects, and events, collaborating with the Production Design team and the creative director to develop worldbuilding systems; Collaborate with the Development team to create real-time tools for implementing the narrative content in the experience; Work with the Game Design team and Creative Director to define the flow of events, overseeing dialogues, animations, audio, event timings, props, etc.; Create functional documentation to keep the team and stakeholders informed about the narrative elements; Ensure the project is understandable and cohesive from the user’s perspective, following and reporting on user tests; Produce summaries of the narrative content for distribution, such as festival registrations and pitch decks; Build a repertoire of narrative VR experiences and present new immersive experiences to the team.  MUST HAVE: Exceptional writing ability; Fluency in Portuguese and English; Willingness to observe, absorb, and modify their work per project needs; Strong interpersonal skills for effective communication across disciplines; Previous experience in narrative content creation teams; Constantly seeking to learn new skills and expand their repertoire; Ability to give and receive constructive and creative feedback; Deep understanding of narrative structures, plot beats, emotional progression, and classical storytelling elements; Ability to balance narrative, interaction, and ludology aspects in immersive experiences, integrating story and gameplay; Passion for movies, TV, visual arts, literature, theater, and great stories across media; Experience in scriptwriting for film, TV, or games; Technical or Bachelor of Arts degree in Cinema, Media, Creative Writing, Literature, or equivalent practical experience; Openness to learning new methods and frameworks.  NICE TO HAVE: Familiarity with Google G Suite and screenwriting software; Previous experience with VR and AR content; Experience working in a studio or production company; Video game industry experience; A passion for Virtual Reality.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Industry experience with best practices within a regulated financial service firm, consumer protection acts, and trading risks preferred. description:

Introduction Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way. Overview Gallagher is a global leader in insurance, risk management and consulting services. We help businesses grow, communities thrive and people prosper. We live a culture defined by The Gallagher Way, our set of shared values and guiding tenets. A culture driven by our people, over 50,000 strong, serving our clients with customized solutions that will protect them and fuel their futures. Arthur J. Gallagher is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Senior Accounting Analyst  to join our team for a systems implementation project, deploying JDE ERP/GL/AP/PO/FA, Kyriba (Treasury), Circulus (AP Automation) and Concur (T&E). This role will play a critical part in ensuring the successful integration of accounting systems, processes, and controls. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in accounting, financial analysis, and systems implementation, with the ability to collaborate across departments to achieve project goals. How you\'ll make an impact Systems Implementation Support:Assist in the implementation and integration of new accounting systems for Accounting (General Ledger, Chart of Accounts), Finance, Fixed Assets, Accounts Receivable, Trade and Non-Trade Accounts Payable, Procurement, Treasury Management (Kyriba), Tax, Master Data, Travel & Expense (Concur), Operations, and other business areas. Collaborate with IT and project teams to ensure accounting requirements are accurately captured and incorporated into system design. Participate in system testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure functionality aligns with accounting standards and business needs.   Process Improvement:Analyze current accounting processes and identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements. Develop and document new workflows and procedures related to the implemented systems.   Data Migration and Reconciliation:Support data migration efforts, ensuring accuracy and completeness of financial data transferred to the new financial systems. Perform reconciliations to validate data integrity post-migration.   Training and Documentation:Provide training and support to accounting staff on the new system functionalities. Create detailed documentation for system processes, workflows, and user guides.   Brazil Localization, Controls & Compliance:Ensure system design meets Brazilian accounting, tax and regulatory requirements (e.g., SPED ECD/ECF, withholding taxes, ICMS / ISS/ IOF / PIS / COFINS, CNAB banking files), aligning with global accounting policies (IFRS/US GAAP) and internal control frameworks (SOX, Segregation of Duties). Review impacts on financial close, reconciliations, tax calculations and audit requirements. Validate rules related to taxes, reporting, electronic documents, and other local obligations. Assist in preparing financial reports and analyses during the transition period.   Cross-Functional Collaboration:Work closely with stakeholders across Corporate and Local accounting teams, IT, implementation partner and operations to ensure alignment and smooth implementation. Act as a liaison between accounting and technical teams to address system-related issues.    About you Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA or equivalent certification is a plus. 3+ years of experience in accounting, financial analysis, or related roles. Solid grounding in Accounting/Finance processes (period close, accruals, reconciliations, AP/AR, T&E), with understanding of IFRS/US GAAP; Brazil statutory/tax familiarity is essential. Proven experience implementing systems such as JDE, Kyriba, Concur or AP automation tools. Experience with integrations, data migration and banking processes. Understanding of Brazilian tax and accounting rules is required. Proficiency in accounting software and ERP systems (e.g., JDE, SAP, Oracle, Workday). Advanced Excel skills and familiarity with data analysis tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work with global teams in different time zones. Languages: English – mandatory; Portuguese – mandatory; Spanish – fluency is a strong advantage. Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid).    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Somos a ERO,  uma mineradora que nasceu no coração do Brasil e cresceu levando para o mundo mais força e energia — uma força que impulsiona setores produtivos e contribui para o desenvolvimento de diferentes regiões.  Desde 1979, quando iniciou suas atividades na unidade Caraíba, a empresa vem consolidando sua presença no setor mineral brasileiro, expandindo para a mina de ouro em Xavantina, avançando na implantação da unidade Tucumã — que promete se tornar um dos principais polos de produção de cobre do país. Nosso crescimento é movido pela experiência em exploração, que nos ajuda a expandir a vida útil de nossas minas e a avançar em novos projetos, como o Projeto Furnas, no Pará.  Nosso jeito de trabalhar reflete os valores que nos guiam: cuidamos da segurança das pessoas, das comunidades e do meio ambiente; temos coragem para inovar e buscar sempre melhores resultados; atuamos com honestidade e transparência em todas as relações; valorizamos a colaboração como força para crescer junto; e buscamos a excelência em cada projeto.  ✨ Vem construir a sua história com a gente!   #VemPraEro #TrabalheConosco #Oportunidade  A Ero está crescendo — e esse pode ser o seu momento!   Acreditamos que cada pessoa tem algo único a oferecer — e é isso que torna nosso time mais forte.  Queremos conhecer profissionais talentosos de diferentes áreas e níveis de formação: médio, técnico e superior.Procuramos pessoas com atitude, vontade de aprender e crescer com a gente.  Cadastre seu currículo e venha fazer parte de um ambiente onde as diferenças são bem-vindas, o desenvolvimento é contínuo e as oportunidades são reais.   Se você quer crescer profissionalmente e fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza o seu potencial, seu lugar pode ser aqui!   Seu próximo passo de carreira pode começar agora.  Pré-requisitos obrigatórios:    Buscamos profissionais com abertura para o aprendizado, com determinação e dedicação;  Profissionais que acreditem em nossos valores;  Perfil curioso, colaborativo e inovador;  Ter 18 anos ou mais;  Ensino médio completo, curso técnico ou superior;    Oferecemos salário competitivo  Previdência Privada  Convênio Médico  Assistência Odontológica  Refeição no local de trabalho (nas unidades)  Vale Refeição (nos escritórios)  Vale Alimentação  Gympass – Wellhub  Convênio com Clube - pode variar conforme localidade  Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida (Empresa cidadã)  Auxílio na compra de óculos para a família  Somos a Ero, uma das principais produtoras de cobre e ouro do Brasil.  Fazemos parte de um grupo global com sede no Canadá e presença forte no Brasil. Temos duas operações de cobre: a Caraíba, na Bahia, e a Tucumã, no Pará. Além disso, nossa mina de ouro Xavantina, está localizada no Mato Grosso.  Nosso crescimento é movido pela experiência em exploração, que nos ajuda a expandir a vida útil de nossas minas e a avançar em novos projetos, como o Projeto Furnas, no Pará.  Em tudo o que fazemos, nossa missão é clara: produzir de forma responsável os minerais essenciais para um futuro melhor.   Nós nos importamos profundamente com o bem-estar de nossas pessoas e comunidades, porque sabemos que cuidar uns dos outros é um dos nossos maiores valores. Além do Cuidado, valorizamos e cultivamos a Coragem. Temos a coragem de inovar, evoluir e enfrentar os desafios que estão por vir.  Nós somos a Ero: uma empresa que une nossas operações no Brasil com expertise global e perspectivas diversas. Juntos, estamos crescendo cada vez mais fortes, trabalhando para alcançar nossa visão de nos tornarmos a melhor empresa de mineração do país.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Sobre a Diaverum: A Diaverum é a empresa líder a nível internacional na prestação de cuidados renais, com foco em melhorar a vida renal dos pacientes - permitindo-lhes viver uma vida plena. A nossa experiência em cuidados renais remonta há mais de 25 anos e temos estado na vanguarda do setor desde então. As nossas operações abrangem atualmente 24 países, com mais de 14.000 funcionários motivados que atendem uma base de pacientes de mais de 40.000 indivíduos. Atividades:  Fornece terapia de diálise crônica, incluindo, mas não se limitando à formulação de um plano de diálise com ultra filtração, iniciando a diálise através de vários acessos, cumprindo as medidas de segurança e monitorando os sinais vitais do paciente aplicáveis aos pacientes com insuficiência renal crônica de acordo com o Plano de Cuidados. Prepara e administra medicamentos, fluido terapia ou outros tratamentos apropriados por prescrição médica e realiza as respectivas documentações no prontuário do paciente. Analisa dados do paciente; avalia e monitoriza o status dos acessos vasculares, revisa resultados laboratoriais, avaliações de pacientes e relata quaisquer alterações ou anormalidades relevantes ao médico plantonista. Monitoriza o sistema de tratamento de água de diálise para uso de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos. Montar e verificar o funcionamento dos aparelhos de hemodiálise, garantindo que todos os dispositivos estejam limpos, funcionais e calibrados. Avaliar as condições clínicas do paciente antes e após a sessão, incluindo sinais vitais e acesso vascular. Observar continuamente os sinais vitais e os parâmetros do aparelho durante a hemodiálise para garantir a eficácia e a segurança do tratamento, ajustar o fluxo sanguíneo e os parâmetros da máquina conforme necessário. Realizar uma avaliação inicial detalhada, coletando informações sobre sintomas, histórico médico e alterações recentes no estado de saúde. Inspecionar e cuidar do acesso vascular para prevenir infecções e complicações, instruir o paciente sobre cuidados domiciliares com o acesso. Manter registros detalhados sobre o tratamento, incluindo dados vitais, parâmetros da máquina, e qualquer evento adverso. Assegurar que a documentação seja completa e precisa. Relatar alterações no estado do paciente e resultados das sessões à equipe médica e outros profissionais de saúde envolvidos no cuidado. Assegurar que todos os procedimentos sejam realizados de acordo com as normas e protocolos estabelecidos pela Diaverum Brasil. Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora. Experiência em projetos de grande escala e ambientes de alta disponibilidade.  Certificações em AWS, Azure, ou Google Cloud. title: Category Leader - Brazil, Brazil Store
description:
Confira a vaga para Category Leader - Brazil, Brazil Store em região geográfica intermediária de são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer‑centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world‑class e-commerce. Amazon.com.br is an important and fast growing business for Amazon. We are looking for an extraordinarily motivated and talented Category Leader with a strong customer focus to join our retail business. This role will have responsibility for owning end‑to‑end of a category, in areas such as vendor management, inventory management, and online content management. You will lead a high performing team whose primary goal is to build and grow our business online, crafting the earth's greatest shopping experience. Functional responsibility of the role spans the full spectrum of e‑commerce including strategy definition, product acquisition, buying, merchandising, pricing, planning, project management, and marketing management.  Key Job Responsibilities   Strategy Definition: Understand and have an in‑depth knowledge of the retail business in Brazil, develop and foster clear and comprehensive strategic objectives for the business and drive them through implementation.  P&L responsibility: Drive the top and bottom line, optimizing all aspects of the category P&L by delivering the right mix of selection expansion, smart pricing, efficient inventory management, margin improvements, top‑notch customer experience, merchandising and traffic generation, and new product development.  Buying, Forecasting & Inventory Management: Resolve customer needs, grow selection across brands, handle vendor partners, optimize vendor terms, and efficiently manage inventory.  Online Store management and demand generation: Responsible for pricing, site merchandising, demand generation and complete customer experience, including inventing new site features to drive higher conversion rates and overall top‑line sales.  Product management: Drive new product innovation, including site features and improvements as well as new sourcing solutions.  Process Improvement: Invent and drive continuous process improvement and automation across systems to scale.  Team talent management: Effectively recruit and develop the best talent, and optimally direct the work and organization goals to deliver bold results.    Basic Qualifications   Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a technical or analytical discipline  Experience managing P&L  Experience working with a cross‑functional team  Experience leading cross‑organizational programs and setting and holding teams and individuals to timelines and deliverables without explicit authority  Speak, write, and read fluently in English    Preferred Qualifications   Experience with commercial agreements  Knowledge of marketing fundamentals and implementing them in creative ways    Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
